statusMeaning: Families define the full scope. Progress records verified subsets only; presence of an upstream test file is not native acceptance evidence.

progress.managedFoundation: Numeric runner, reactive ownership, spring playback, numeric/grid/automatic/randomized/typed-unit staggering, nested timelines/callbacks, scalar replace property/set tracks, typed numeric CSS custom-property endpoints and standalone timers; 441 unfiltered tests pass normal Release and Traced Debug on the current Windows host.
progress.playbackTiming: Timing geometry matches55 pinned-source cases/929 samples; callback/control state matches51 traces. Public Timer with uint/float duration, typed count/forever repeat, speed/FPS and actual Ranvier ownership matches18 admitted-frame source traces. Seven state and eleven scheduler/lifetime tests cover reentry, late frames, active owner disposal and validation. Real Traced WebCore JIT smoke verifies repeats/completion and active callback disposal. Numeric/timeline repeat-direction-speed integration, global engine arbitration and a fresh PE replay for the added timer remain incomplete.
progress.easing: 46 default named easings plus one Bezier and two step-mode fixtures match 441 upstream samples; runner consumes custom easing with tested reentrant cancellation and seek. Full easing parameter domains, irregular and multi-stop linear remain incomplete.
progress.springs: Physical/perceived spring modes, parameter clamps/mutations, perceived completion and settling-duration playback compare against twelve constructor and six mutation snapshots. Whole-millisecond perceived input accepts uint; precise fractional input remains supported.
progress.staggering: 67 numeric/geometry/random fixtures,7 unit fixtures and7 timeline-position fixtures cover step/range, origins, explicit and automatic 2D/3D geometry, axes, reversal, easing, start, modifiers, total overrides, index mapping, random origins, seeded jitter and checked typed CSS output. Existing DOMPointInit and Element APIs support measured positions; recording-interface tests verify centers and measurement counts. Actual native layout/unit integration and string-label stagger starts remain incomplete.
progress.timelines: 29 pinned position cases,3 synchronized-child traces,7 stagger offset cases,6 callback traces,2 nested-controller traces and56 scalar property schedules (32 generated); manual controls, scalar replace/set composition within a controller, callback suppression/reset, cycle rejection, ancestor guards and Ranvier ownership pass. Timer tracks, additive/blend/global cross-controller composition, keyframes, directions/loops/speed, removal, stretch/refresh/revert and completion promises remain incomplete.
progress.nativeIntegration: Fresh public-feed-only CSS alpha.2 normal Release and Traced Debug strict NativeAOT publishes and real-host PE executions pass with pinned private Core/View source and verified ABI62 runtime. Schema-2 receipts bind pre/post authored inputs, actual nupkg-entry/cache/app/ILC DLL identities and executable; failure/timeout regressions pass. Both managed suites pass354/354 on the new public CSS defaults. Smoke covers typed CSS style/layout, real scheduling and disposal after completion preventing retargeting. Historical private CSS70ac evidence remains intact and opt-in. Broad native coverage, active-frame/host-disposal lifecycle tests, hardware acceleration and matched public-cohort acceptance remain incomplete.
